Annihilate the enemy of the U.N. Forces:
the Anti-U.N. Forces.
Commencing the operation to wipe out the U.N.'s foe: the "Anti-U.N. Forces." Annihilate the Anti-U.N. TYPE-29 fighter formation.

rows.notes: Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en: The "VF-0": a variable fighter developed with the ASS-1's OverTechnology. To survive the battles ahead, you'll now undergo VF-0 conversion training.

Annihilate the Anti-U.N. Forces'
new variable fighter unit.
The Anti-U.N. Forces made a surprise attack with VFs built using our tech. Sortie at once and annihilate the Anti-U.N. variable fighters.

As part of your training,
fight a mock battle against Major Focker.
To prepare for the escalating Anti-U.N. war, we'll hold a mock battle drill. Win the mock battle against U.N. Forces ace Major Roy Focker.

To stop the theft of the AFOS fragment,
annihilate the Anti-U.N. Forces.
The Anti-U.N. Forces are trying to seize the AFOS fragment on Mayan Island. Expect unfamiliar underwater combat, but wipe out the Anti-U.N. at all costs.

To defend the AFOS fragment,
annihilate the Anti-U.N. Forces.
The Anti-U.N. Forces attack the Asuka to seize the AFOS fragment under study. Defend the carrier Asuka and annihilate the Anti-U.N. at all costs.

Escort the allies recovering the AFOS
fragment to the target area.
We'll now recover another AFOS fragment newly found on Mayan Island. Escort the allied units recovering it to the target area.

Wipe out the Anti-U.N. Forces so they
can't recover the Bird Human's head.
We lost the Bird Human's head in a fierce battle with the Anti-U.N. Forces. We can't let them recover it. Wipe out the Anti-U.N. Forces searching for it.

To seize the immense power of AFOS,
wipe out the Anti-U.N. Forces.
Both the U.N. Forces and the Anti-U.N. Forces now hold AFOS fragments. Wipe out the Anti-U.N. to claim the AFOS fragments for our U.N. Forces.

Wipe out the giant aliens who struck
back after the Macross's attack.
rows.notes: Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en: At its launch ceremony, the Macross fired its main gun at an unknown fleet. Battle with the aliens looks unavoidable. Get into intercept position now.
rows.notes: Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines). Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines).

rows.en:
Wipe out the giant alien ground forces
attacking the Macross.
To escape the giant aliens' attack, the Macross now attempts a space launch. Escort the blundering VF-1D while wiping out the giant alien ground forces.

Defend the Macross
during the Transformation.
Beginning the Transformation to fire the main gun at the giant alien fleet. Defend the Macross at all costs while the Transformation is under way.
Our rookies lack experience, so we'll now hold a mock battle as training. Win the mock battle against U.N. Forces ace Major Roy Focker.

Defend the Macross until
its main gun fires.
To break out of this defensive fight, we'll surprise-attack the giant aliens. Defend the Macross until its main gun fires.

To resupply, carry the containers
to the designated point.
With supplies drained by repeated battles, we'll restock at Sara Base on Mars. Recover the supply containers. If enemies appear, switch to wiping them out.
Destroy the enemies nearing the Macross.
Enemy units spotted approaching the Macross. A scramble has been ordered. Miss Macross may be on your mind, but go at once and wipe out the enemy.

Escort the Cat's Eye until the survey
of the giant aliens is complete.
Just short of Earth, the giant aliens have demanded the Macross surrender. We'll recon to learn their aims. Escort the Cat's Eye and wipe out the enemy.

To escape from the enemy ship,
head for the target area.
We've rescued Lt. Hayase and the others held captive on a Zentradi battleship, but we haven't escaped the enemy ship yet. Get out of it at all costs.

To make it back to Earth no matter what,
wipe out the Zentradi forces.
The Zentradi have surrounded the Macross to stop it from returning to Earth. It's a hard-line move, but destroy the Zentradi to break their encirclement.

Wipe out the Zentradi forces
that have attacked the Macross.
The Zentradi have attacked the Macross, back on Earth after a year away. Wipe out the Zentradi forces trying to smoke the Macross out into space.

To keep the enemy off the Macross,
wipe out the Zentradi forces.
A Zentradi battleship is closing fast on the Macross as it resupplies at sea. We can't let the Macross's resupply be interrupted. Wipe out the Zentradi.

To get the civilians safely onto Earth,
wipe out the Zentradi forces.
The Ontario Autonomous Zone has agreed to take in the Macross's civilians, but the Zentradi have appeared. Wipe them out so the civilians can be taken in.

Escort the liaison shuttle headed
for U.N. Forces HQ on Earth.
You'll now escort the liaison shuttle taking Capt. Hayase to U.N. HQ on Earth. Escort it until it reaches a safe zone, then switch to wiping out the enemy.

Beat the expert gamers at the smash-hit
game "Battroid Attack".

Head-to-Head Valkyrie Simulation  ~BATTROID ATTACK!!~
                                  PLEASE INSERT COIN(S)
rows.notes: Arcade attract-screen layout kept exactly as MUF shipped it (line break and space padding).

rows.en:
Wipe out the Zentradi forces
launching an all-out attack.
At humanity's first interstellar wedding, the Zentradi attacked the Macross in force. We've taken a first step to peace; don't stop now. Wipe out the enemy.
rows.notes: Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines). Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines).

rows.en:
To end the interstellar war,
destroy Boddole Zer.
rows.notes: TM had 'Golg Boddole Zer'; the Japanese here is the short form (Boddole Zer), and the glossary keeps the full name for titles. MI_060 (u2918), which writes the full name, keeps it.

rows.en: Fearing the power of Earth's culture, Boddole Zer attacks the Macross all-out. We'll use the Minmay Attack to overturn hopeless odds. Destroy Boddole Zer.

Put down the rioting Zentradi
at once.
Zentradi who can't fit in on Earth stole arms and are attacking civilian areas. We cannot let civilians come to harm. Put down the rampaging Zentradi.

To capture the automated spaceship
factory, seize control of the facility.
To build up our forces, we'll seize the Zentradi automated spaceship factory. Wipe out the Zentradi forces defending it and take the factory.
rows.notes: Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines). Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines).

rows.en:
Wipe out Quamzin's faction, which is
trying to steal the micronization device.
Quamzin, who won't coexist with Earthlings, is raiding the factory to steal the micronization device. We can't allow that. Wipe out Quamzin's faction.

To rescue the hostages,
wipe out Quamzin's faction.
Quamzin has taken civilians hostage and is demanding a battleship as ransom. Rescuing the hostages safely comes first. Wipe out Quamzin's faction.

Wipe out Quamzin's faction, which is
trying to steal the reaction engine.
Quamzin's faction is raiding the industrial zone to steal the reaction engine. Wipe them out to protect the reaction engine in the industrial complex block.

To protect the Macross and Macross City,
wipe out Quamzin's faction.
Out to destroy the Macross, Quamzin's faction has suddenly hit Macross City. Wipe them out at once to protect the Macross and the people of Macross City.

To make it home to Earth,
annihilate the Zentradi forces.
As the Macross heads home from beyond the solar system, the Zentradi appear. First break their formation with reaction weapons, then annihilate them.

Capture the U.N. Forces pilot who is
flying a Valkyrie without authorization.
We've spotted a pilot flying a Valkyrie around Saturn without permission. Unauthorized use of a Valkyrie won't be tolerated. Capture the pilot at once.

To rescue the hostages,
head to the target area immediately.
The Zentradi have taken Macross crew members captive. To rescue the hostages, infiltrate the enemy ship and go at once to where they're thought to be held.

As part of your training,
fight a mock battle against Max.
To prepare for relentless Zentradi raids, we'll now conduct special training. Win a mock battle against the rumored genius pilot, Maximilian Jenius.

Immediately annihilate the Meltrandi
forces approaching the Macross.
rows.notes: TM 'Annihilate the Meltrandi forces closing in on the Macross at once' read as if the Meltrandi were closing in at once; moved 'immediately' to the verb.

rows.en: Bogeys believed to be the all-female Meltrandi forces are nearing the Macross. To keep them from getting any closer, annihilate the Meltrandi at once.

To end the interstellar war,
defeat Golg Boddole Zer.
Peace with the Zentradi up in smoke, Boddole Zer attacks the Macross all-out. We'll use the Minmay Attack to overturn hopeless odds. Defeat Boddole Zer.

As part of your training, fight
mock battles with the Destroid squads.
To prepare for emergencies like a Zentradi remnant revolt or unseen threats, regular U.N. Forces training begins. Beat each Destroid squad in mock battle.
Rioting Zentradi remnants have ignored a call to surrender and still run wild. To put down the riot at once, annihilate the Zentradi remnants.

To assess your aptitude as a test pilot,
fight the Valkyrie squad in a mock battle.
This test assesses your aptitude as a test pilot for Project Super Nova, the next main VF contest. Win the mock battle against the Valkyrie squad.

Collect as many of the targets placed
around the area as you can.
A flight test of the prototype's thrust, mobility and flight performance begins. Collect more of the area's targets than the rival model.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Destroy the targets as you
head for the target area at speed.
To test the prototype's agility, we'll fly it in a confined space like a base. Run a time trial: destroy all targets and reach the target area.

Destroy as many enemies as you can
within the 5-minute time limit.
To gauge the prototype's combat ability, we'll now stage an arena mock battle. Battle a large number of targets, simulating combat against multiple enemies.

Stop the bombers escorted by VF-11s
from reaching the target area.
For prototype combat data in varied settings, a mock air battle now begins. Destroy the VF-11 and drone-escorted bombers short of the target area.
Defeat the rival aircraft in the competition.
For head-to-head prototype data, we now hold a mock battle against the rival. Needless to say, it's the most crucial test for selection. Win at any cost.

Destroy the auto-defense satellite
and descend to Earth amid its debris.
U.N. soldiers have run amok in Macross City during the memorial ceremony. Destroy the orbital auto-defense satellite and descend amid its debris.
rows.notes: The ceremony (kinen shikiten) is the commemoration in Macross City (Macross Plus finale); 'run amok' for bousou (the soldiers are under Sharon's control). Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Intercept the YF-21
alongside the YF-19.
The joy of reaching Earth is short-lived: the YF-21 is blocking your path. There's no more time to waste. Intercept the YF-21 alongside the YF-19.

To stop Sharon's rampage,
destroy Sharon immediately.
Sharon Apple has run out of control and seized U.N. Forces central command. To free the people her song is manipulating, destroy Sharon immediately.
Wipe out the unknowns that just appeared.
A vanguard craft reports to Battle 7 a surprise attack by an unknown force. Annihilate the unknown units to keep them off the Macross 7 fleet.
rows.notes: zenei-tei = a small vanguard craft of the fleet. Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
As part of training,
fight a mock battle against Gamlin.
Danger always lurks on a journey through vast space. To prepare for the worst, beat Diamond Force member Lt. Gamlin Kizaki in a training mock battle.

Recover the containers holding citizens
and annihilate the Varauta Army.
Citizens kidnapped by the Varauta Army are being carried off in containers. Annihilate the Varauta escort and bring the containers to the designated area.

Retake the fold generator, then defend
it and annihilate the Varauta Army.
The Varauta Army is trying to re-fold City 7, now cut off from Battle 7. Retake the generator, annihilate the Varauta Army and stop the re-fold.

Protect as many civilian craft as
possible while wiping out the Varauta Army.
rows.notes: Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en: The Varauta Army suddenly appeared during the crowded Battroid Carnival. Keep citizens safe: guard the Monsters while annihilating the Varauta Army.

To protect the citizens of City 7,
annihilate the Varauta Army.
Battle 7's relief escorts were wiped out instantly by a mysterious Varauta foe. Annihilate the Varauta Army to protect the citizens of City 7.

Annihilate the Varauta Army that's
blocking the escape from the blazing star.
rows.notes: Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en: City 7 is being pulled toward a blazing star, and the Varauta Army has struck amid the crisis. Annihilate the Varauta Army and escape the star.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Annihilate the Varauta Army, which has
launched a large-scale attack.
Varauta forces struck suddenly near Lux. Macross 7 faces its worst crisis yet. Sink the Varauta flagship to break their chain of command and end this crisis.

Destroy the Protodeviln,
or survive for 5 minutes.
We've spotted a likely Protodeviln, approx. 300 m long, unlike any foe so far. Make survival your top priority, and destroy the Protodeviln if possible.

Stop the Protodeviln coming to save
their comrade from reaching the target area.
rows.notes: Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en: We captured a Protodeviln, but let its would-be rescuers break into Battle 7. Annihilate the intruders and stop them from seizing the Protodeviln.
The Protodeviln have gotten serious and are attacking the Macross 7 fleet. We can't let the Protodeviln beat us here. Annihilate the Varauta Army.

As part of training,
fight a mock battle with the legendary duo.
Ahead of the escalating Protodeviln war, a mock battle will now be held. Beat the married duo: a genius pilot of old in the latest model, and an ex-ace.

Annihilate the Varauta Army to carry
out Operation Stargazer.
We now launch Operation Stargazer, a surprise assault by a small elite force. Wipe out the Varauta Army at all costs to fire reaction weapons into the cave.

Shoot down Gamlin, who is being
controlled by the Protodeviln.
Capt. Gamlin, possessed by the Protodeviln, is on a rampage, wrecking bases. We can't allow more damage. You're authorized to shoot down Capt. Gamlin.

To protect the peace of the galaxy,
destroy Gepelnitchi.
To thwart Gepelnitchi's ambition, the "Spiritia Farm Project," and to protect galactic peace, destroy Varauta Army commander Gepelnitchi.

Annihilate the rogue Meltrandi fleet
that has launched an attack.
A vanguard ship has been wiped out by a large rogue Meltrandi fleet. They mustn't get any closer to the Macross 7 fleet. Annihilate the rogue fleet.

Arrest the poachers trying
to poach the Galaxy Whales.
Galaxy Whales are nearing orbit; we've detected likely poachers hunting them. Arrest them once confirmed. You may ignore the civilian craft also spotted.

As part of training,
fight a mock battle against Patrol officers.
When the Galaxy Whales near Zola, poachers flock to the planet in droves. To prepare, the Zolan Star Patrol holds its regular training: a mock battle.
The Galaxy Whales are nearing Zola again: prime hunting season for poachers. We can't ignore their poaching any longer. Take the poachers into custody.

Escort Officer Liza to the target area
and arrest the poachers.
Undercover with the poachers, Officer Liza is fleeing in a stolen VF-17. Escort her to the target area, then arrest the poachers and black marketeers.
rows.notes: Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 characters (2 lines).

rows.en:
Protect the Galaxy Whale from the
reaction weapon and arrest the poachers.
Poachers aim a reaction weapon at the white Galaxy Whale hampering their hunt. Protect the whale from the weapon at all costs and arrest the poachers.

To stop them from entering Island 1,
annihilate the unknown lifeforms.
An unknown enemy downed a New U.N. aircraft. Its heavy EM jamming seems to hide the details. Head to the scene at once and annihilate the enemy.

As part of training, fight a mock
battle against the New U.N. Forces.
A mock battle now begins as our regular joint drill with the New U.N. Forces. Show them what S.M.S. can really do, and win the mock battle.
Annihilate the Vajra that have reappeared.
The enemy that hit Macross Frontier never left; it lurks in Island 3's base block. Wipe out the Vajra to keep them away from Island 1.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
As part of the S.M.S. applicants' final
test, fight Pixie Team in a mock battle.
rows.notes: Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en: The final test for S.M.S. applicants begins now. To help out, join the applicants in a mock battle against Pixie Team, led by Capt. Klan Klang.

Scout the thieves' hideout, and if they
attack, annihilate the thieves.
The New U.N. Forces have asked us to scout a thieves' hideout. If the thieves attack once you're there, you are authorized to engage them.

As part of training, fight a mock battle
against S.M.S. Skull Squadron.
To prepare for Vajra attacks, a mock battle begins now. Beat Maj. Ozma Lee's Skull Squadron, one of the finest elite units in all of S.M.S.

To save the Galaxy fleet's surviving
ships, wipe out the Vajra.
rows.notes: Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en: We'll now rescue the surviving Macross Galaxy ships under Vajra attack. Wipe out the Vajra blocking the survivors' escape from the combat zone, now.

Wipe out the Vajra together
with the Macross Quarter.

Jeffrey: "Attention, all units in the field. This ship will now engage the Vajra carrier
          in close-quarters combat. All hands! Transformation!!"
rows.notes: Speaker-label briefing laid out like MUF's shipped Ranka/Sheryl briefings (label, quote, indented second line). 'Vajra carrier' for the Japanese 'Vajra kuubokan' (glossary unit: Carrier-class Vajra). 'All hands!' for zenkan.

rows.en:
Wipe out the Vajra that appeared
while surveying their nest.
We found a Vajra nest and began a survey, aiming to grab a cocoon if possible, but the Vajra spotted us almost at once. Move swiftly to wipe them out.

Quell the Zentradi riot
that broke out on Gallia 4.
A performance crew on a morale tour of planet Gallia 4 has been taken hostage by rioting Zentradi. Put down the riot to rescue them.

Clear out all the Vajra cocoons
aboard the Global.
The Global, 117th Research Fleet flagship found on planet Gallia 4, has become a Vajra lair. To stop the Vajra breeding, clear out every Vajra cocoon aboard.

Destroy the giant Vajra ship believed
to be commanding the Vajra.
The Frontier fleet is now in crisis under organized Vajra attacks. Head for the giant Vajra ship believed to be giving the orders and destroy it at once.

Wipe out the Vajra so they can't disrupt
the experiment using Ranka Lee's song.
Top-secret mission: you will now guard an experiment using Ranka Lee's song. Until the experiment begins, wipe out the Vajra so they can't interfere.

Defend the Macross Quarter and wipe out
the Vajra or survive for 5 minutes.
Evolved Vajra have appeared that even reaction weapons can't harm. They'll be hard to destroy: put defending the Macross Quarter and survival first.
rows.notes: Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines). Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines).

rows.en:
Defend the Battle Frontier for 5 minutes
as it prepares a super-long-distance fold.
To end the war with the Vajra, a super-long-distance fold has been decided on. Defend the Battle Frontier until the super-long-distance fold begins.

Wipe out the Vajra rampaging
inside the Frontier.
A Vajra nest was apparently built inside Macross Frontier, and swarms of Vajra are rampaging inside. Wipe out the Vajra that have emerged in the Frontier.

Stop the deserters who stole the Macross
Quarter from escaping.
Some S.M.S. members have hijacked the Macross Quarter to flee. If they fold out, they'll get away. Stop the deserters from escaping.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
To test the VF-171EX, hold a mock battle
with the Sagittarius Squadron.
A mock battle will now be held to test the VF-171EX, built to fight the Vajra. Defeat the Sagittarius Squadron in this combined machine test and training.

To make the Vajra homeworld ours,
wipe out the Vajra.
At last we've found the Vajra homeworld; our only hope is to make it our new home. With the Galactic Fairy's song, wipe out the Vajra.
rows.notes: TM 'Wipe out the Vajra, powered by the Galactic Fairy's song' read as if the Vajra were powered by the song; the Japanese means 'using the Galactic Fairy's singing voice as our strength'. Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
For the peace of the galaxy,
defeat Grace O'Connor.
Grace O'Connor's group, who'd use even the Vajra to seize the galaxy, were the true masterminds. For the peace of the galaxy, defeat Grace O'Connor.

Wipe out the unknown lifeforms
that have invaded Island 1.
Capt. Gilliam has gone ahead in pursuit of the unknown enemy that invaded the Frontier. Back him up at once and annihilate the unknown enemy.
rows.notes: Giriamu taii in a Frontier mission (MK_020, invasion of Island 1) = Henry Gilliam, S.M.S. captain (glossary, male).

rows.en:
As part of training, fight the Vajra
in a simulator battle.
Simulator training for Vajra attacks begins. The data recreates Vajra combat exactly, so treat this drill as real and wipe out the Vajra.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Beat the expert gamers at the smash-hit
game "Battroid Attack F".

Head-to-Head Valkyrie Simulation  ~BATTROID ATTACK!! F~
                                  PLEASE INSERT COIN(S)
rows.notes: Arcade attract-screen layout kept as MUF shipped the original Battroid Attack line (u2891).

rows.en:
Ozma: "As of now, we at S.M.S. launch the rescue operation for the Galaxy
      fleet's refugee ships! Mission code......"
rows.notes: Speaker-label briefing in MUF's speaker layout (label, quote, indented second line).

rows.en:
Wipe out the Vajra that
appeared in the Frontier fleet.
The Vajra have followed the Galaxy refugee ship we rescued and appeared at the Frontier. Wipe them out at once so they get no closer to the Frontier.

Wipe out the Vajra while
guarding the concert venue.
The Vajra have broken into the Frontier and are attacking a concert venue full of civilians. Protect the venue and wipe out the Vajra at once.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en: Wipe out the rogue Zentradi forces.
Unidentified units, likely rogue Zentradi, are near Jupiter. Break their will to fight with Operation Minmay, then annihilate them.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Wipe out the mysterious mecha
rampaging through the city.
Mecha from a mysterious fleet slipped through our defenses and invaded Earth. Wipe out the mobile weapons ravaging the city as if seeking something. Now!

Escort Lt. Silvie to the target area
and annihilate the Mardook forces.
At the Moon Festival, the Mardook forces abducted Lt. Silvie. Escort Lt. Silvie as she escapes, then annihilate the Mardook forces.
rows.notes: Moon Festival (Macross II event) is not in the glossary. Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en: We've rescued the civilians held captive on a Mardook battleship, but we haven't escaped the enemy ship yet. Get out of it at all costs.

Wipe out the Mardook forces seeking
to destroy Earth's culture.
The Mardook forces have launched an all-out assault to destroy Earth's culture. Protect Earth's culture at all costs and wipe out the Mardook forces.
The Mardook advance won't stop, and the U.N. Forces are now in dire straits. To break out of this, the Macross will fire its main gun. Escort the Macross.

As part of the event, fight a
mock battle against Capt. Nexx.
rows.notes: Nekkusu taii = Nexx Gilbert (glossary needs_check); the Japanese uses the short name.

rows.en: As part of the Moon Festival events, a mock battle now begins. Win the mock battle against U.N. Forces ace pilot Capt. Nexx.

As part of training, fight a mock
battle against the Faerie Squadron.
To prepare for battle with the rogue Zentradi, a mock battle now begins. Win the mock battle against the Faerie Squadron, led by Lt. Silvie Gena.

As part of conversion training,
fight a mock battle on the ground.
As part of conversion training, a mock battle on the ground now begins. It may be training, but stay sharp: wipe out the enemy and win the mock battle.

As part of conversion training,
fight a mock battle in the air.
As part of conversion training, a mock battle in the air now begins. It may be training, but stay sharp: wipe out the enemy and win the mock battle.

As part of conversion training,
fight a mock battle at sea.
As part of conversion training, a mock battle at sea now begins. It may be training, but stay sharp: wipe out the enemy and win the mock battle.

As part of conversion training,
fight a mock battle in space.
As part of conversion training, a mock battle in space now begins. It may be training, but stay sharp: wipe out the enemy and win the mock battle.

Believe in the power of culture
and destroy Boddole Zer's fleet.
rows.notes: Boddole Zer kantai: Boddole Zer's fleet (not the glossary's 'Boddole Zer Main Fleet', which is a different Japanese term).

rows.en: A huge Zentradi horde has appeared and is about to invade Earth again. Annihilate the Zentradi forces at all costs to protect Earth from this crisis.

Support Basara in his song
battle with an unknown unit.
A Song Energy experiment detected abnormal Song Energy from a remote planet. Investigate it with Basara, who has already rushed ahead.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Wipe out the Vajra
to defend Macross City.
Vajra controlled by Grace have suddenly appeared in Macross City on Earth. We can't let Macross City come to harm. Wipe out the Vajra at once.

To retake the communications relay base,
wipe out Vindirance.
We move to retake the relay base seized by the anti-U.N. group Vindirance. Enter via the canyon and wipe out the Vindirance guards.
rows.notes: 'communications' dropped from 'relay base' to fit two lines (the objective row u3062 names it in full). Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Wipe out Vindirance, who are scheming
to fold to Earth.
Vindirance is plotting a fold to Earth. It must be stopped at all costs, so reaction weapons are authorized for this operation. Wipe out Vindirance.

To shatter Latence's ambitions,
destroy the Macross.
We'll now descend to Earth and infiltrate Macross City. To shatter Latence's ambitions, destroy the jamming system mounted in the Macross's head.

rows.notes: Akumu = Nightmare, the VF-17's nickname (cf. u0314 'Nightmare Assault Operation').

rows.en: The VF-17 series: variable fighters nicknamed "Nightmare." Wipe out the VF-17 series to shake off the swarm of Nightmares bearing down on you.

Win the battle against the units
with "Red" as their main color.
"Red": the color said to stand for passion... Win the battle against these hot-blooded guys, who let that very feeling blaze wildly.

Win the battle against the units
with "Blue" as their main color.
"Blue": the color said to stand for calm... Win the battle against these cool guys, who are never swayed by that kind of feeling.

Destroy every generation of Queadluun
as you head for the target area.
While you toured a base storing every generation of Queadluun, the Queadluuns somehow went on a rampage. Destroy them as you escape to the target area.

Win the battle against every
generation of Destroid.
Overshadowed by variable fighters, the Destroids rarely got to shine. Now they have revolted to show what they can do. Put them down.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Win the mock battle against the special
forces unit Moon Island Platoon.
A mock battle now begins vs. the special forces unit codenamed "Moon Island". They're all problem children, but reportedly skilled. Defeat Moon Island.
An observation ship reports a horde of large battleships advancing on Earth. We can't let them get any closer to Earth. Annihilate them at once.

rows.notes: Choujikuu yousai = Super Dimension Fortress, as in the glossary work title. 240 px against a ~175 px estimate; the name cannot be shortened, and shipped objective lines reach 274 px.

rows.en: The Macross ended the interstellar war, and colony ships across the galaxy took its name. Beat them and surpass the Super Dimension Fortress!
rows.notes: Imin-sen = colony (emigrant) ships, the Macross-named fleets. Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Win the dogfight against variable
fighters of every generation.

A dogfight against the variable fighters of every era now begins. As a Valkyrie
pilot, you must never lose. Win, whatever it takes.

Between sky and earth,
show your strength!
rows.notes: Flavor title. Line 1 is a little over the estimated box (the Japanese is only 7 characters); other objectives in this box run far wider.

rows.en:
Ranka: "I think this mission will be a tougher fight than any before...
But I'll cheer you on with all my heart! Please win... you have to win!"
rows.notes: Ranka speaks politely to the player here (watashi, desu/masu). Second sentence repeats 'zettai' with a pause: kept as a halting repetition.

rows.en:
On the starlit stage,
show your strength!

Sheryl: "This mission is going to be a tougher fight than ever before.
But I'm the one cheering you on, so you'd better win, no matter what!"

Win the battle against
Vermillion Flight.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Vermillion Flight.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Vermillion Flight.

Win the battle against
the Skull Leaders.
rows.notes: Skull Leaders = the Skull Squadron leaders of each era (Focker, Hikaru, Max in this mission). Plural of the glossary mission title 'Skull Leader'; the team name itself is not in the glossary.

rows.en:
To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Skull Leaders.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Skull Leaders.

Win the battle against
the 2090s ace pilots.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the ace pilots of the 2090s.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the 2090s ace pilots.

Win the battle against Armored
Valkyries of every era.

To test your combat experience, you will now battle the Armored Valkyries of every era.
Trust in your skill and defeat them all.
rows.notes: Glossary 'Armored Valkyrie' is provisional. Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Win the battle against
Sound Force.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Sound Force.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Sound Force.

Win the battle against
the Protodeviln.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Protodeviln.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Protodeviln.

Win the battle against
the Sturmvogel IIs.
rows.notes: The Japanese says only 'Sturmvogel'. The enemy team (Max, Milia, Gamlin) flies VF-22S Sturmvogel II, so 'Sturmvogel IIs' (glossary unit name).

rows.en:
To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Sturmvogel IIs.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Sturmvogel IIs.

Win the battle against
Pixie Team.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Pixie Team.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Pixie Team.

Win the battle against
the Meltrandi aces.
rows.notes: Japanese uses the short form 'Meltran' + gekitsuiou (flying ace); the team is Milia and Chlore, so plural.

rows.en:
To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Meltrandi aces.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Meltrandi aces.

Win the battle against
Sagittarius Squadron.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Sagittarius Squadron.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Sagittarius Squadron.

Win the battle against S.M.S.
Skull Squadron.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle S.M.S. Skull Squadron.
Trust in your own skill and defeat S.M.S. Skull Squadron.

Win the battle against
Diamond Force.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Diamond Force.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Diamond Force.

Win the battle against
Antares Squadron.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Antares Squadron.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Antares Squadron.

Win the battle against the
Mardook commander.
rows.notes: Japanese has no number; the mission's only named enemy is Feff, so singular.

rows.en:
To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Mardook commander.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Mardook commander.

Win the battle against the Destroid
Monsters of every era.
rows.notes: Konig Monster, Destroid Monster and Prototype Monster in this mission.

rows.en:
To test your combat experience, you will now battle the Destroid Monsters.
Trust in your skill and defeat the Destroid Monsters of every era.
rows.notes: First mention has no 'rekidai' in the Japanese, the second has it; kept that way. Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Win the battle against
Moon Island Platoon.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Moon Island Platoon.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Moon Island Platoon.

Win the battle against the
next-gen main VFs.
rows.notes: Jiki shuryoku kahen sentouki = the next main variable fighters (Isamu's YF-19, Guld's YF-21 in Project Super Nova).

rows.en:
To test your combat experience, you will now battle the next-generation mainstay VFs.
Trust in your skill and defeat them all.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Win the battle against
the Bird Human.
rows.notes: Line 1 is over its per-line estimate only because the Japanese line 1 is 5 characters; the row stays within the other objectives' width.

rows.en:
To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Bird Human.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Bird Human.

Win the battle against
Golg Boddole Zer.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Supreme Commander Golg Boddole Zer.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Boddole Zer.
rows.notes: Kantai shirei choukan = Supreme Commander (glossary alias). The Japanese repeats the full title; the second mention is shortened to 'Boddole Zer' to fit two lines.

rows.en:
Win the battle against
the Mardook fleet.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Mardook fleet.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Mardook fleet.

Win the battle against
Sharon Apple.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle Sharon Apple.
Trust in your own skill and defeat Sharon Apple.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle His Excellency Gepelnitchi.
Trust in your own skill and defeat His Excellency Gepelnitchi.
rows.notes: Kakka = 'His Excellency', as in the prefilled MC_110 briefing (u3204).

rows.en:
Win the battle against
the Vajra Queen.

To put your combat experience to the test, you will now battle the Vajra Queen.
Trust in your own skill and defeat the Vajra Queen.
Win the fight against Hayao Kakizaki.

Hayao Kakizaki gripes that his machine is why he never gets to shine.
To shut him up, beat Kakizaki in mock battles in all sorts of units.
rows.notes: Kanshou = win completely; rendered 'beat outright'. Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en: Fight wild with a burning heart!

Basara: "From here on, it's time for our FIRE BOMBER red-hot live show!
All right, let's go out with a bang! Listen to my song!!"
rows.notes: FIRE BOMBER in capitals as the Japanese writes it (glossary alias). Catchphrase per glossary note.

rows.en:
Set your ecstasy ablaze
in a one-of-a-kind fight!

Sheryl: "From here on, it's time for a special live show. Ready, Ranka?"
Ranka: "Yes! Everybody, hold me tight! To the ends of the galaxy!! Kira☆"
rows.notes: Sheryl says 'Ranka-chan'; mission text follows the MUF style without honorifics (brief), so 'Ranka'. Ranka's catchphrase at full force. Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines). Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines).

rows.en:
You who trust your wings,
race beyond time and space!

Fold quartz, which can leap even time and causality, has brought pilots and
machines from across time and space. Win this dreamlike battle against them!
rows.notes: Japanese: win the dreamlike battle against the many pilots and machines from beyond time and space who appeared through fold quartz's power. Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines). Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines).

rows.en:
Clear the "Macross Zero"
missions in a row

You will now take on the 8 "Macross Zero" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!
Clear the "Macross Zero" missions in a row

Find the Bird Human's head and
retrieve it to the target area.

The Bird Human's head: another AFOS fragment, newly found on Mayan Island.
Find it before the Anti-U.N. Forces do and bring it to the target area.

Clear the "Super Dimension Fortress
Macross" missions in a row
rows.notes: x2. Series title without the leading 'The' to fit the line. Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en:
You will now take on the 17 "Super Dimension Fortress Macross" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!

You will now take on the 8 "Super Dimension Fortress Macross" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!

Clear the "Do You Remember Love?"
missions in a row

You will now take on the 8 "Do You Remember Love?" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!

Clear the "Macross Plus"
missions in a row

You will now take on the 13 "Macross Plus" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!

Pass each waypoint as it is designated,
as quickly as you can.

A flight test now begins to measure the prototype's thrust, agility and more.
Run a time trial to measure how long you take to clear all the waypoints.

Subdue the U.N. soldiers who've run
amok at the anniversary ceremony.
rows.notes: Prefilled line was over the box; compressed 'U.N. Forces soldiers who have' to 'U.N. soldiers who've'.

rows.en:
U.N. troops have run amok at the anniversary ceremony in Macross City, Earth.
To end this crisis of unknown cause, subdue the rampaging soldiers at once.

Clear the "Macross 7"
missions in a row

You will now take on the 14 "Macross 7" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!

Just as City 7 is dragged toward a blazing star, the Varauta Army attacks.
Annihilate the Varauta Army at once and escape from the star.

Clear the "Dynamite 7"
missions in a row
rows.notes: Japanese writes 'Dynamite 7' without 'Macross'; kept as written.

rows.en:
You will now take on the 5 "Dynamite 7" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!

Clear the "Macross Frontier"
missions in a row
rows.notes: Japanese 'Macross F'; glossary work title 'Macross Frontier'.

rows.en:
You will now take on the 23 "Macross Frontier" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!

The Victors that struck Macross Frontier never left; they seem to be hiding
in Island 3's foundation block. Annihilate them before they near Island 1.

Wipe out the Vajra that suddenly
appeared during the survey of their nest.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en:
A concert tour crew visiting planet Gallia 4 to boost morale has been taken
hostage by rioting Zentradi. Wipe out the rioting Zentradi to rescue them.

Organized Vajra attacks have put the Frontier fleet in grave danger.
Head for the giant Vajra ship believed to be giving orders. Destroy it at once.

Wipe out the deserters trying to escape
in the stolen Macross Quarter.

Some S.M.S. members are trying to hijack the Macross Quarter and escape.
At this rate they'll fold away. You're authorized to shoot down the deserters.

Clear the "False Songstress"
missions in a row
rows.notes: Glossary short form for tight UI ('The False Songstress' in full).

rows.en:
You will now take on the 6 "False Songstress" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!
rows.notes: Same short form as u3175 for consistency.

rows.en:
Clear the "Super Dimension Fortress
Macross II" missions in a row
rows.notes: Japanese gives the full title of Macross II. Break moved: a 47-byte objective line was longer than any Japanese line (46).

rows.en:
You will now take on the 7 "Super Dimension Fortress Macross II" missions back to back.
Expect long, fierce fighting. Steel yourself and go!

Win consecutive battles
against ace pilots
rows.notes: x3. No final period, as in the Japanese and the other chain objectives.

rows.en:
You will now fight ace pilots in battle after battle.
Expect grueling, fierce combat. Steel yourself and go!

You will now fight the bosses in battle after battle.
Expect grueling, fierce combat. Steel yourself and go!

Roy Focker: the U.N. ace who loves booze, women, and above all the open sky.
Defeat Focker, whose skills have made him the very model of a pilot.

Shin Kudo washed up on Mayan Island and grew through the many people he met.
Defeat Shin, the idiot who'd throw his life away for the woman he holds dear.

Seize victory from the duo
of Ivanov and Nora.

D.D. Ivanov and Nora Polyansky: the aces of the Anti-U.N. Forces.
Defeat this dangerous couple, whose skills ran the U.N. Forces ragged.
Seize victory from the Bird Human.

Sara Nome, Guide of the Wind, charged with stopping the Bird Human's revival.
Defeat the Bird Human, revived in spite of all her efforts.

Seize victory from the genius Max
and the ace Milia.

Genius pilot Max and ace Milia, who made the first-ever interstellar marriage.
Defeat the Jenius couple, also a bridge to peace with the Zentradi.

Quamzin Kravshera, boss of the Quamzin family, notorious as the Ally Killer.
Defeat Boss Quamzin, in such a fine mood he's riding a Destroid Monster.
Seize victory from Golg Boddole Zer.

Golg Boddole Zer: Zentradi Supreme Commander over a full 5 million ships.
Defeat the ruthless Boddole Zer, who'd readily kill his own troops to win.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines). Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines).

rows.en:
Seize victory from the duo
of Isamu and Guld.

Isamu and Guld: stuck together since childhood, they fight whenever they meet.
Defeat the Dalmatian High School duo, seemingly at odds but friends at heart.
Maximilian Jenius, space carrier Battle 7's captain and a commander of genius. Defeat the Battle 7, which fought its way through the fierce Protodeviln war.
rows.notes: Prefilled (MUF). Review: the Japanese has no real line break, only a full-width yen-n typo between the two sentences (MUF noted it would display literally and shipped an ASCII backslash-n break there). This cell is not a backslash-n cell (lit_nl false, no WRAP), and insert_text refuses a real newline in a CSV cell, so the English is one line. FOR THE BUILD LEAD: about 965 px on one line will not fit the 2-line briefing box; break it after 'genius.' (mark the occurrence lit_nl or WRAP) if the build should match MUF.

rows.en: Seize victory from Gavil and Glavil.

Gavil, a Protodeviln with a unique sense of beauty, and Glavil, a monster-like
Protodeviln of immense combat power. Defeat the Beauty and the Monster.

rows.notes: Prefilled; kept ('Triumph over' rather than 'Seize victory from', fine).

rows.en:
His Excellency Gepelnitchi: Varauta supreme commander, mightiest Protodeviln.
Defeat His Excellency Gepelnitchi, who could drain the galaxy of its Spiritia.

Gamlin Kizaki, elite pilot of the U.N. Forces' Diamond Force.
Defeat Gamlin, nicknamed "Martian" as a child for his wide forehead.

Seize victory from the duo
of Basara and Graham.

Graham, who hates and would kill the Galaxy Whales, and Basara, who was
moved to sing to them. Defeat these men burning with passion for the whales.

Ozma Lee: seasoned S.M.S. Skull Squadron leader, overprotective of his sister.
Defeat Ozma, who smashed death flag after death flag throughout the story.

Seize victory from Jeffrey,
captain of the Macross Quarter.

The Macross Quarter: ARMD-class in size, yet it bears the name Macross.
Defeat the Macross Quarter, captained by Jeffrey Wilder.

Klan Klang, Pixie Team leader, clumsy not just in her genes but in love too.
Defeat Klan, a maiden sunk in rage and grief after losing the one she loved.

Seize victory from the duo
of Alto and Brera.

"Being linked to you made it clear. However far you go, people are alone!"
"That's why we...!", "But!!", "It's precisely because we're alone that...",
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. Quotes exchanged in the Macross F finale; the Japanese ends on a comma and so does the English.

rows.en:
Manipulated by Grace, Ranka Lee guards the Vajra planet to atone for her sins.
Defeat Ranka, who sings to protect the Vajra homeworld.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. 'Vajra planet' then 'Vajra homeworld' follows the two different Japanese words.

rows.en: Seize victory from the Vajra Queen.

Even the Protoculture feared their power, envied it, and at last deified them,
copying their form: the super-dimensional Vajra. Defeat Grace's Vajra Queen.
Seize victory from the Mardook fleet.
Seize victory from the Vajra fleet.
Seize victory from the Hound Vajra.

Ranka: "I, Ranka Lee, am gonna explain the basic Fighter mode controls!
        I'm nervous I won't explain it well, but I'll do my best. Kira☆"

Sheryl: "Oh, fine. I'll explain the basic Battroid mode controls for you.
         Sheryl herself is explaining, so don't you dare miss a single word."

Ranka: "Okay! Next, I'll explain the basic GERWALK mode controls.
        Listen to me and get the GERWALK mode controls down perfectly!"

Sheryl: "It's a pain, but next I'll explain the basics of shooting attacks.
         You've got ME explaining, so if you don't learn it, you'll be sorry."

Ranka: "Umm... here I'll explain the basics of melee attacks.
        It's tough with so much to learn, but I'll do my best explaining too!"

Sheryl: "Here I'll mostly explain the special maneuvers related to piloting.
         If you're aiming to go pro, you'd better learn at least this much."

Ranka: "Here I'll mainly explain the SP-related special maneuvers.
        They look a bit hard, but listen closely and learn them well, okay?"

Sheryl: "All right, next I'll explain container transport.
         I'm the one explaining it. Of course you'll pick it up right away."
Practice piloting in Real Flight Mode.

Ranka: "Sheryl and I are going to show you how to fly in Real Flight Mode!"
Sheryl: "You don't get service like this very often, so be grateful."

rows.notes: Matches the prefilled 'Practice Special Maneuvers 1/2' (u3234, u3236).

rows.en:
Sheryl: "I'll explain the special controls for skills and support."
Ranka: "Explaining with Sheryl makes me nervous, but I'll do my best!"
rows.notes: Ranka says 'Sheryl-san'; mission text follows the MUF style without honorifics, as the prefilled u3241 ('Sheryl and I').

rows.en:
Ranka: "Here I'll explain the Anti-Missile Action."
Sheryl: "Keep up with our explanation at Macross speed!"
rows.notes: 'Macross speed' renders makurosupiido, a play on 'Macross' + speed; kept literal.

rows.en:
Sheryl: "Last of all, I'll explain the newly added controls."
Ranka: "Thanks so much for listening all the way to the end!"
Train at the ground training field.

Sheryl: "Now you're going to do combat training at the ground training field.
         There are targets on the field too, so train however you like."
Train at the space training field.

Ranka: "Now you're going to do combat training at the space training field!
        There are targets on the field too, so train however you like!"
Train at the in-base training field.

Sheryl: "Now you're going to do combat training at the in-base training field.
         There are targets on the field too, so train however you like."
Train at the indoor training field.

Ranka: "Now you're going to do combat training at the indoor training field!
        There are targets on the field too, so train however you like!"
Train at the flight training field.

Sheryl: "Now you're going to do combat training at the flight training field.
         There are targets on the field too, so train however you like."

TYPE-14
A U.N. Forces fighter developed as the TYPE-4's successor.
It specializes in fleet air defense.

ADR-03-Mk III Cheyenne
An early Destroid fixed on the carrier Asuka as an AA battery.
It fought hard against SV-51s to defend the Asuka.

VF-0D Phoenix
The two-seat VF-0 of Shin and Edgar. Its two seats suggest a
trainer, but it outmaneuvers the A type in air combat.

VF-0A Phoenix
The standard VF-0, flown mostly by rank-and-file pilots. It
fought fierce variable fighter battles with the Anti-U.N. Forces.

VF-0S Phoenix (Roy)
Flown by Roy Focker in a new kind of transforming dogfight
against Ivanov, an Anti-U.N. pilot and his former superior.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. Japanese label says 'Focker's unit'; the prefilled '(Roy)' is left as MUF shipped it.

rows.en:
HWR-00-Mk I Prototype Monster
Prototype of the super-heavy Monster. The U.N. Forces' trump
card, it fired reaction weapons at the Bird Human.

TYPE-29
An Anti-U.N. Forces fighter, developed to counter the TYPE-14.
It excels in local-theater combat.

SV-51α (Standard)
An Anti-U.N. Forces variable fighter. Its original swing-wing
design makes it agile despite its size. Fought on Mayan Island.

SV-51γ (Nora)
Upgraded SV-51α. It gave the U.N.'s Shin Kudo a hard fight and took Sara, the Mayan Island priestess privy to the Bird Human's secret.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. Review: restored 'Mayan Island' (in the Japanese, dropped in English). Compressed to keep 2 wrapped lines.

rows.en:
SV-51γ (Ivanov)
Flown by Ivanov, Focker's former CO. It fought Focker's VF-0S
in a duel to the death. It bears a red skull as its personal mark.

Octos
An amphibious Anti-U.N. Destroid. Deployed en masse for the
Mayan Island landing, it made full use of being amphibious.

Bird Human (AFOS)
A god from Mayan Island legend. The U.N. and Anti-U.N. Forces
fought over its power, said to be enough to destroy the world.

ADR-04-Mk X Defender
Twin AA guns on both arms and a big radar for very long-range
space combat. Defended the Macross in place of gun batteries.

MBR-07-Mk II Spartan
Built for melee with giant aliens. After the war, it also put
down riots by aliens who could not adjust to life on Earth.

SDR-04-Mk XII Phalanx
Missiles packed on both arms. With too few batteries after the
Zentradi raid, it served as the Macross's anti-air fire.

MBR-04-Mk IV Tomahawk
Big beam cannons on both arms, plus missiles, MGs and more.
Ready for any front: ship assaults, city defense, interception.

HWR-00-Mk II Monster
Four big cannons on its head, missile launchers on its arms.
The U.N. Forces' top firepower, but heavy arms make it slow.

VF-1D Valkyrie
The two-seat VF-1A, used mainly for training. Caught up in the
Zentradi raid, Hikaru Ichijyo flew it and saved Minmay.

VF-1A Valkyrie (Standard)
The Macross's most common variable fighter, flown by regular
pilots. It can handle any battlefield, from the ground to space.

VF-1A Valkyrie (Max)
Max's personal unit, painted blue. Same specs as the standard
model, but its genius pilot drew the eyes of friend and foe.

VF-1J Valkyrie (Hikaru)
Hikaru Ichijyo's unit after he became a U.N. Forces pilot.
It beats the A type, and twin head lasers add firepower.

VF-1J Valkyrie (Max)
Issued to Max after he married Milia. It too is painted blue.
Flying with Milia's red unit, he racked up even more victories.

VF-1J Valkyrie (Milia)
Issued to Milia after she married Max. It too is painted red.
Flying with Max's blue unit, she racked up even more victories.

VF-1S Valkyrie Roy Focker Special
A high-performance unit for commander-class pilots. After
Focker fell, his junior Hikaru flew it to defend the Macross.

SDF-1 Macross Daedalus Type
An alien battleship that suddenly fell to Earth. Through it,
humanity met OverTechnology far beyond any existing tech.

VT-1 Super Ostrich
A two-seat trainer. Hikaru took it without permission for a
Saturn date with Minmay, but the Zentradi captured them.

VF-1A Valkyrie (Hikaru)
Hikaru's VF-1A from the movie. Flying it, he defied Misa's
orders to rescue Minmay, and so the love triangle began.

VF-1S Valkyrie (Hikaru)
A high-performance unit for commanders. In the final battle, it
charged the foe's ship with the Macross and beat Boddole Zer.

VF-1S Valkyrie (Max)
A high-performance unit for commander-class pilots. Max flew
it as Skull Squadron leader and won his duel with Milia.

VF-4 Lightning III
Developed as the VF-1's successor. When the Megaroad-01 set
out, Hikaru flew it as the ship's air group commander.

SDF-1 Macross Armored Type
An alien battleship that suddenly fell to Earth. In the movie,
unlike the TV series, it has ARMD-01 and ARMD-02 as its arms.

Regult
The Zentradi forces' most widely used battle pod. Swapping
weapons suits it to any operation. The troops think it's so-so.

Glaug
A high-performance unit with big cannons on both arms, plus
many lasers and guns. Quamzin's unit, it plagued the Macross.

Nousjadeul-Ger (TV)
A humanoid powered combat suit, nimbler and comfier than
a Regult, with shoulder cannons and many handheld weapons.

Nousjadeul-Ger (Movie)
A humanoid powered combat suit, nimbler and comfier than
the Regult. Its design differs between TV and movie.

Queadluun-Rau (Standard)
A high-performance Meltrandi battle suit. Highly mobile, it
menaced Valkyrie squadrons with big guns and many missiles.

Queadluun-Rau (Milia)
Milia's red personal unit, unbeaten and feared even by allies.
After a fierce dogfight, Max got on its tail and shot it down.

Queadluun-Rau (Max)
The blue unit Max flew after marrying Milia and growing to
Zentradi size. Paired with Milia's unit, it scored big wins.

Zentradi Soldier
A Zentradi rank-and-file soldier. Despite wearing only a space
suit, at over 10 m tall they can match a Battroid hand to hand.

HWR-00-Mk II Monster (Ridden by Quamzin)
A Monster with a delighted Boss Quamzin astride it. Apparently
he wanted to imitate a Western he'd once seen.

Vrlitwhai Kridanik
A Zentradi fleet commander. Tougher than common troops, he
can briefly work unprotected in space. A strong fighter too.

Golg Boddole Zer
Zentradi Commander-in-Chief. Core bio-unit of a mobile
fortress built 120,000 cycles ago; bigger than other Zentradi.

VF-11B Thunderbolt
Developed to succeed the VF-1 as main fighter. Isamu flew it
while hunting Zentradi remnants scattered across space.

YF-19 Excalibur (Isamu)
New engines gave it high mobility but made it hard to handle --
a wild bronco that Isamu called his "little cutie."
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. '--' is plain ASCII (no em dash).

rows.en:
YF-21 Sturmvogel (Guld)
A unit piloted by brain waves. To stop Sharon's new unmanned
fighter Ghost, Guld made a suicide charge that downed both.

X-9 Ghost
An unmanned fighter hijacked by Sharon Apple. Its very high
mobility toyed with Guld, but his suicide charge downed both.

VF-11C Thunderbolt
The U.N. Forces' main unit from 2040 on. Its forgiving handling
and easy upkeep kept it the mainstay for a long time.

VF-17D Nightmare (Standard)
A stealth unit for special missions, large and heavily armed.
After the Protodeviln appeared, it mainly defended City 7.

VF-17S Nightmare (Kinryu/Gamlin)
A VF-17 upgraded for commanders. After leader Kinryu died,
Gamlin became leader of Diamond Force and flew this unit.

VF-17S Nightmare (Milia)
To protect City 7, cut off from the fleet by an enemy ploy,
Mayor Milia flew this VF-17S, repainted red.

VF-19F Excalibur (Standard)
Deployed to Emerald Force. The YF-19's peaky handling was
toned down so that rank-and-file pilots could fly it.

VF-19S Excalibur (Docker)
Docker's unit as leader of Emerald Force. Unlike the standard
unit, it adds four anti-air beam guns for more firepower.

VF-22S Sturmvogel II (Max)
Max sortied in it to attack the Protodeviln nest. A high-end
unit packed with new tech, such as solo fold capability.

VF-22S Sturmvogel II (Milia)
Milia's red unit. She fought beside Max in Operation Stargazer,
and once even sang in it with a Sound Booster fitted.

VF-19 Kai Fire Valkyrie (Basara)
A modified VF-19. Its bright red frame has a big speaker and
speaker pods, and it roamed the galaxy blaring Basara's songs.

VF-11MAXL Kai Mylene Valkyrie (Mylene)
A VF-11 modified for Mylene, its Battroid mode distinctly
feminine. She sang with Basara, the battlefield her stage.

VF-17T Kai Storm Valkyrie (Ray & Veffidas)
A modified VF-17T. Ray and Veffidas flew it together as
FIRE BOMBER members, firing up live shows even in battle.

Battle 7
Macross 7 fleet flagship, captained by Maximilian Jenius. Its
trump card, the Macross Cannon, got it through many crises.

Queadluun-Quilqua
An upgraded, modified Queadluun-Rau. Emilia Jenius, daughter of Max and Milia, flew it in a singing showdown with Basara.

Fz-109A Elgersoln (Standard)
A variable fighter for rank-and-file Varauta Army pilots. Said
to derive from the U.N.'s VF-14, but nobody knows for sure.

Fz-109F Elgersoln (Gigile)
The Fz-109's commander model. Mainly Gigile's, it attacked
Basara & co. repeatedly; Gamlin's team downed it over City 7.

Az-130A Panzersoln
A variable attacker the Varauta Army made by upgrading the
Elgersoln. Its extra power made life harder still for Macross 7.

FBz-99G Zaubergeran (Gavil)
Gavil's own unit, a mighty variable bomber with all sorts of
weapons. Supposedly. Yet Gamlin often downed it in one hit.

Queadluun-Rau (Chlore)
Personal unit of Chlore, who leads a rogue Meltrandi fleet.
Pilot skill plus performance let it land a hit on Basara himself.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. Chlore's gender is unknown in the glossary; the line uses no pronoun for Chlore.

rows.en:
Glavil
Gavil's physical body. It needs so much Spiritia that Gavil takes
a small spirit form, merging into Gavigla to fight all-out.

Gepelnitchi
Leader of the Protodeviln. To build a world of endless Spiritia,
he attacks humans, the "Spiritia-regenerating race" he sought.

VT-1C Valkyrie
A variable trainer for basic training. Basara flew it to make
the Galaxy Whale hear his song, but the whale shot it down.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. Japanese names it 'VT-1C Valkyrie' here, not 'Ostrich'.

rows.en:
VF-17D Nightmare (Liza)
The unit Liza stole while fleeing smugglers. Whether the bill for it ever reached the Zolan Star Patrol is anybody's guess.
rows.notes: tm reviewed; added 'while' so Liza is the one fleeing, not stealing from fleeing smugglers.

rows.en:
VF-5000T-G Star Mirage
A two-seat VF-5000 of the Zolan Star Patrol. With a Super
Booster fitted, it played a key role in arresting the poachers.

VF-5000G Star Mirage
A VF-5000 of the Zolan Star Patrol. Liza complained that
it carried nothing but non-lethal weapons.

VF-19P Excalibur
The unit Basara forced his way into to sing to the Galaxy
Whale. Whether Ray was billed the rental is anybody's guess.

VF-22S Sturmvogel II (Gamlin)
Gamlin's own unit in his signature black. To let Basara's song
be heard, he fought the poachers without quite knowing why.

VA-C-3 Invader
The poachers' main variable attacker, with harpoon launcher
pods to catch Galaxy Whales and whaling mods all over it.

Diving Suit
The suit Graham Hoilie wore to fight the Galaxy Whale.
Harpoon in hand, he fought the white whale to the death.

Cheyenne II
An anti-air interceptor Destroid, a redesign of the Cheyenne.
It put its firepower to full use in the Macross Attack.

VF-171 Nightmare Plus
Main variable fighter of the Frontier fleet. Weaker than its base
VF-17, but easier for ordinary pilots to handle.

VF-171EX Nightmare Plus (Standard)
A VF-171 refit to fight the Vajra. Mainly flown by rank-and-file
U.N. Forces pilots, it fought to defend the Frontier.

VF-171EX Nightmare Plus (Alto)
Alto's unit as Sagittarius Squadron leader. Hardly a poor
performer, but it couldn't keep up with Alto's skill.

RVF-171EX Nightmare Plus (Luca)
The unit Luca flew when Jeffrey and the others deserted.
For electronic warfare, it is fitted with a radome and Ghosts.

VF-25F Messiah (Alto)
Cutting-edge unit sent to military provider S.M.S., partly for
testing. Alto's F type is built for high-mobility combat.

VF-25S Messiah (Ozma)
The gray unit of Ozma, S.M.S. Skull Squadron's leader. It beats
the standard model, and is formidable with Armored Parts on.

VF-25G Messiah (Michael)
The VF-25's long-range combat custom, painted blue for Michael. Its sniper rifle and long-range head stand out.
rows.notes: Japanese has Mihaeru (not Mishel), so 'Michael' per the brief. Note: u1069 (VF-25G short label) renders the same name as 'Michel'.

rows.en:
RVF-25 Messiah (Luca)
The VF-25's electronic-warfare custom. Luca's is light green.
Has a big back radome and carries remote-piloted drones.

Queadluun-Rhea (Standard)
Evolved Queadluun-Rau with a back beam cannon and better
arm weapons. Deployed mainly as the Pixie Team's mainstay.

Queadluun-Rhea (Klan)
Klan's own unit, in her signature crimson. With Klan's great combat skill, it held its own against even the VF-25 in battle.

Klan Klang
Pixie Team leader Captain Klan Klang, in her macronized form.
Raging and grieving at Michel's death, she mowed down Vajra.

VB-6 Konig Monster
A variable bomber based on the Monster. It excels at mobile
hit-and-run attacks and boasts awesome, unrivaled firepower.

Macross Quarter
Only ARMD-class in size, yet it bears the Macross name.
This agile, hard-hitting ship was once seized by pirates.

Battle Frontier
The linchpin of Frontier's defense: a huge multirole stealth
attack space carrier. In a crisis, it houses the government.

Vajra (S)
Small type of an insect-like alien life form. Its head fires
energy blasts and homing missiles. Its tail blade allows melee.

Vajra (L)
Over 5 times the small type's size, with great firepower: a big
back beam that smashes battleships in one hit, missiles, guns.

VF-27 Lucifer (Standard)
Built from the YF-24 exclusively for cyborg soldiers. Its
mobility is too extreme for a flesh-and-blood body to endure.

VF-27 Lucifer (Brera)
Brera's personal VF-27, in his signature color, purple.
Its high performance troubled Alto's team time and again.

Battle Galaxy
Macross Galaxy's Battle-class carrier. Thought lost in a Vajra
attack, it was in fact part of a plot by Grace and her allies.

YF-25 Prophecy
The VF-25's test model, developed from the YF-24. Its head carries multiple sensors so it can record data.

VF-25A Messiah (Standard)
The basic VF-25, able to take on many tactical roles with optional gear. S.M.S. flies it, partly for performance evaluation.

VF-25S Messiah (Klan)
The commander unit of Klan, S.M.S. Pixie Team leader. Like her Queadluun-Rhea, it bears her signature crimson.

Macross Quarter
Only ARMD-class in size, yet it bears the Macross name. It mounts the Quarter Cannon, with overwhelming destructive power.
rows.notes: 'Quarter Cannon' is not a glossary entry (plain rendering of the katakana).

rows.en:
Hound Vajra
A mantis-like Vajra with scythes on both arms. It caught Ranka in its abdomen to carry her off, but why remains unknown.
rows.notes: Hound Vajra is a provisional glossary entry.

rows.en:
VF-2SS Valkyrie II
The U.N. Forces' main Valkyrie, built with Zentradi technology.
Silvie and others flew it with distinction against the Mardook.

VA-1SS Metal Siren
Built as the U.N. Forces' next main unit. On top of the usual 3 modes, it has a 4th, Gundroid mode, which excels in melee.
rows.notes: 'Gunroid' (gandoroido) mode is not in the glossary; romanized as in Macross II sources. Review: 'Gundroid' (glossary).

rows.en:
Proto Metal Siren
The Metal Siren prototype shown to the public at the Moon Festival. The Mardook, appearing out of nowhere, nearly seized it.
rows.notes: Proto Metal Siren is provisional; 'Moon Festival' is not in the glossary. The prototype itself is what the Mardook nearly carried off (rachi = abduct).

rows.en:
SNN Valkyrie
A civilian variable craft owned by SNN. Unarmed and unable to turn into a Battroid, yet it flew every bit as well as military craft.

Gigamesh (Standard)
The Mardook's main mobile weapon, made for melee, with
claws all over its body and wing cutters on its shoulders.

Gigamesh (Feff)
Personal unit of the Mardook forces' Feff, in his signature red. It fought Silvie fiercely inside the ship as she tried to escape.
rows.notes: Review: restored 'Mardook forces' (in the Japanese, dropped in English). Compressed to keep 2 wrapped lines.

rows.en:
VF-1S Valkyrie (Barnrose)
Personal unit of Mariafokina Barnrose, leader of Vindirance.
Pilot skill or specs? Old as it is, it rivaled the newest units.

VF-19A Excalibur Ravens Type
The VF-19 of special forces unit VF-X Ravens. High-performing
but twitchy, it takes great skill to master.

VF-22 Sturmvogel II (Wilbur)
Personal unit of Wilbur Garland, VF-X Ravens commander.
It showed off its might in purging the rebellious Vindirance.

VF-9 Cutlass (Standard)
General Galaxy's first mass-produced variable fighter. Small and light, it has superb combat mobility.

VF-9 Cutlass (Max)
A unit of the Dancing Skull team. Max's, in his signature blue, tore across the battlefield alongside Milia's.

VF-9 Cutlass (Milia)
A unit of the Dancing Skull team. Milia's, in her signature red, tore across the battlefield alongside Max's.

rows.notes: tm 'Macross Frontier' was 105 px in an 87 px box; 'Macross F' (glossary alias) fits and matches u3381 'Macross F Movie'.
